# Cresslet

> Deploy small web apps (static client + optional fetch-handler server with SQLite, files, secrets). Each app is sandboxed on <name>.<domain>.

## Fastest path (CLI)
- `npx cresslet new my-app --api <this server>` then `cd my-app && npm install` (the project remembers the server; default is https://cresslet.dev)
- Edit `src/` (client) and `server/index.ts` (`export default { fetch(req, env) }`, gets `/api/*`)
- `npx cresslet deploy` → prints URL. Then `npx cresslet logs`, `npx cresslet db`.
- Read the app's AGENTS.md for rules.

## Raw HTTP
- POST /v1/deploys {"files":[{"path":"index.html","data":"<h1>hi</h1>"}],"server":"<esm string|null>"} → {app.url, deployKey}
- Reuse: same body + "app":"<name>" + header X-Cresslet-Deploy-Key.
- GET /v1/apps/<name>/logs, GET /v1/apps/<name>/db

## Share a static HTML file or folder as an artifact (account token)
- An artifact: private, link-only or public, expires (default 30 days); no server. Need a server, database or rollback? Deploy an app (above).
- CLI (a version with artifacts: `npx cresslet@latest`; older ones ignore the file and deploy the folder as a public app): `npx cresslet@latest deploy report.html --visibility link --keep 7 [--name q4-report]`; a folder: `npx cresslet@latest deploy ./site --artifact`. Deploying it again updates the same URL.
- POST /v1/pages {"html":"<h1>hi</h1>","name":"<optional address>","visibility":"private|link|public","retentionDays":30|null} → {page.url}; PUT /v1/pages/<name> replaces its files
